data.description:
VRFS is a community-driven soccer (football) simulator focused on realistic physics and competitive multiplayer.

Main features of VRFS:

PHYSICS SIMULATION: Perform almost any trick—from balancing the ball on your foot to executing curved power shots or long passes. The ball’s trajectory is fully determined by the physics engine.

COMPETITIVE MULTIPLAYER: Experience instantaneous ball-touch response. For example, you can finish powerful crosses as fast as in real soccer.

COMFORT: Move with thumbsticks and play seated or standing. No intense hand motions are required.

NO PAY-TO-WIN: Skill determines success. No one can buy “stronger kicks” or “faster boots.” Practice leads to improvement.

FREE FOR ALL: Full access without any mandatory purchases. Optional cool gear is available to support further development.

Please note, VRFS is still in development, with upcoming physics and scenery enhancements. We welcome your suggestions for improvements.

# UPDATE 0.4.7

## Weather Settings
Introducing weather physics with snow, rain, and wind. You can enable any weather on any map in private, solo, and practice modes. However only some of the maps allow weather in public matches. Weather affects ball physics such as drag on the field. Weather is synced for all players in the same lobby and is set by the lobby creator.

## New Starting Arena
Explore the next-gen starting stadium, which will evolve with crowds and additional features in the future. It’s also available in multiplayer.

## Replays Auto Highlights
Enable automatic goal highlights when watching replays.

## New 1v1 Elo Interface
Check out the overall 1v1 Elo chart and use the new "Find Opponent" button for quick matches. 

## Referee Tools
Use marking spray, yellow cards, and red cards. Press (A) to switch tools when in the ref mode. 

## New Scoreboards Designs
Choose from various scoreboard designs for custom arenas.

## Vote Kick
Now available in public lobbies.

## Camera Device Follow Mode
New interface, better performance, and the "Follow Me" mode for the camera device.

## Scoreboards On Custom Arena Goals
Display goal counters on custom arena goals (press settings on the goal when editing your arena).

## Wind Physics Test Bundle
Includes 2 special effect balls created during weather physics development.

## Other
Store Credits item for custom arenas, performance optimizations, updated tutorial, fixed known bugs. 

## Free Collectible 2025 Ball
Find it in the store at the new starting stadium. It will be removed after New Year’s.

# UPDATE 0.4.6

## Christmas Maps
We’ve added Christmas versions of some of the popular maps. Enjoy the festive mood and Christmas atmosphere. Also added some decorations in the arena building.

## 2025 Mega Bundle
New bundle featuring 25 items and a ‘Snowman’ ball with unique tumbler doll physics.

## Voice Chat Settings
Added feature to switch voice chat to team-only or friends-only modes (see in the Settings).

## In-field Bots in Multiplayer Practice
You can now add in-field bots on your custom arenas. They will try tackling the ball all the time. Note that this is in beta and will get improved in the future.

## Portals (Experimental)
Added experimental portals on the starting arena.

## New Bots Training Mode
Updated training bots and introduced bot matches in the 4v4 arena. Access it through the portal in the starting scene.

## Optimized Botkeepers
As you may have noticed, botkeepers on custom arenas were a bit heavy on performance, so we’ve revamped them. 

## New Reporting Interface and Moderation
Your assistance in reporting disruptive players is highly valued. The reporting interface has been upgraded for better usability.

## Tutorial Testing 
We’ve created a tutorial mode for new players. If you’d like to test it and share some suggestions on enhancing it, we’d appreciate that a lot. Enter via the portal on the starting arena.

## New Arrivals
Apart from the Christmas bundle, check out the new arrivals, including the latest winter soccer boots and a few other things. 

## Graphics Settings
You can now switch to higher or lower resolution if you’d like to. 

## Some Bug Fixes
Fixed glitched items in some lockers
Enhanced performance on the VFA arena
Optimized palm trees

# UPDATE 0.4.5

## New Mega Pitch
Added an even larger pitch (way beyond FIFA standards) as it was highly requested by the community. This arena is available for public and private games and in the arena editor.

## Curl Physics Enhanced
The curl physics simulation has been updated to enhance realism, smoothness, and predictability. Let us know what you think about this change. Note that balls with extra curling effects remain unchanged.

## Corner Flags with Physics
Recreated the original corner flags with fully-featured physics for your celebrations.

## Renegade and Razor Bundles
Each bundle includes six items you can mix and match to create unique sci-fi looks.

## New Boots Collection
The new brand with a strange unreadable name “/////” features 16 sports casual boots designs.

## Gloves Dash Disabled
After long consideration, taking into account the new GK mechanics and community feedback, we've disabled the gloves dash. We can switch it back on if the majority wants this.

## Performance Improved
A lot of performance optimizations have been made in the online practice mode and some official maps. We keep on working on more optimizations for the custom arenas to move the limits as far away as possible.

## Other
Fixed some known bugs, potentially improved stick-drift issues, head physics, custom arena thumbnails, and overall performance enhancements.

# UPDATE 0.4.4

## New 4v4 Arena
Meet the new arena featuring a new pitch format available for 3v3 and 4v4 public lobbies and having full-scale goals. There are also outs and throw-ins activated on this arena by default, and it’s heavily optimized.

## Physics Enhanced
Better physics related to when you kick the ball straight up in the air. Note that all other aspects are retained unchanged and untouched. We’d be gathering your feedback on this.

## 50+ New Cool Cosmetics
Check out ‘New arrivals’ in the store.

## Arena Editor Thumbnails
Arena creators now have a special item—a thumbnail camera. Just position it as an object on the arena and it will make arena covers from the point of your choice.

## Other
- Beginner lobbies are now marked with a special badge.
- Color setting for some of the stands in the arena editor.
- ‘Glitch dribbling’ won’t get a free kick anymore.
- Optimized almost all official arenas.
- Stuttering when jumping in locomotion fixed.
- Other minor fixes.

UPDATE 0.4.3 

[ Introducing the Camera Device ]
Record videos inside VRFS! Open the menu and tap the new icon at the top. Move around holding the device, fix it in the air, or even throw it around. We've optimized it to use minimal resources, but be aware that using the device on heavy custom arenas may cause FPS drops.

[ U19 Halloween Bundle ]
The Halloween bundle is available in the store until Halloween. It will be removed from the store afterward, but all purchased items are yours forever.

[ Dark Arena Template ]
A new dark scene is available in the arena builder—perfect for creating scary places. We've also added a pumpkin object to the objects list.

[ New GK in Public Lobbies ]
The new goalie mechanics, which allow catching and throwing the ball, are now enabled in all public match lobbies. We also need your feedback on whether the gloves-dash feature should be removed.

[ Verification Badges ]
Based on initial feedback, we’ve moved the badge to the username instead of the player model. The verified blue check mark will be visible in the player list in the lobby.

[ Bug Fixes and Enhancements ]
We've fixed many issues, including lag when switching jerseys and glove collision problems. Custom arenas have been significantly optimized, especially those with many blocks.

UPDATE 0.4.2

THE VFA ARENA
The VFA league has reached 10k members, so we’ve made an official map. There is an 11x11 public lobby option available in this arena.

STORE ITEMS IN ARENA EDITOR
You can now build shops in the arena editor. Arena authors will receive a store credits reward when an item is purchased in their arena. This way you can support someone who created a cool map. There is also a new ‘Donate SC’ button on the arena info screen.

THROW-INS AND NEW GK MECHANICS IN PRIVATES
Added throw-ins, and you can now switch to the new GK mechanics in private lobbies.

THROWING PHYSICS UPDATE
Fast-moving balls are not magnetized to the gloves anymore.

NEW IN ARENA EDITOR
Fixed bugs and enhanced arena editing. Added a new locomotion mode with no speed cap. Added a new empty scene template.

OTHER
Added 40 new items to the store, including the new ball called ‘FLIGHT PLAN’ because it flies slowly but steadily. Fixed some bugs and made various minor enhancements. Also, gloves now have collisions.

VERIFICATION BADGES
Implemented in this update and we’ll start checking verification requests very soon.
